title: Lossless renormalized high-front permutation

theorem.shell_permutation: H is a permutation on every fixed positive bit-length shell
theorem.return_bridge: for a finite return history of total span B, final R satisfies R>>2B=H^B(z)
theorem.lossless_consequence: the aligned final high front recovers the complete earlier coordinate and, by replay, the complete return history
theorem.cycle_consequence: every finite-shell cycle length is a power of two

scientific_boundary: The theorem identifies a lossless growing high-front code. It does not prove actual return-penalty recurrence, phase-witness complexity divergence, exclusion of eventual center period two, or Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.
